# Phase 1 Quality Checklist: Test Infrastructure & Fixture Safety Net

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, testability, and governance quality of Phase 1 requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md) | **Tasks**: [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on the feature context, Constitution, and Phase 1 scope.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Scope Discipline & Boundary Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are the boundaries of Phase 1 strictly restricted to test infrastructure (`pyproject.toml`, `tests/`), offline fixtures, and developer docs? [Clarity, Plan §Phase 1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are non-goals explicitly defined prohibiting any modifications or refactoring to application code (`f2m.py`) in this phase? [Completeness, Plan §Phase 1, Tasks §Phase Overview]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the task list prevent unrelated refactoring or drive-by cosmetic modifications? [Consistency, Constitution Principle IX, Tasks §Phase Overview]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the branch isolation requirement clearly defined for this phase? [Governance, Constitution Principle VI]

---

## 2. Existing Behavior & Regression Coverage

- [ ] CHK005 Are regression requirements specified for all critical legacy parsing routines (`clean_title`, `parse_filename`, `parse_selection`, `parse_listing`, `parse_post`, `parse_categories`)? [Coverage, Spec §IV, Tasks §3]
- [ ] CHK006 Are Persian-specific title prefixes and noise patterns explicitly listed for title sanitization testing? [Clarity, Spec §2.5, Tasks §T009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are Persian comma (`،`) and range selection formats specified in interactive selection requirements? [Completeness, Spec §2.3, Tasks §T011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are multi-season and multi-quality parsing expectations defined for series fixture testing? [Coverage, Tasks §T008, Tasks §T014]

---

## 3. Testability & Offline E2E Verification

- [ ] CHK009 Are test dependencies and framework versions (`pytest>=7.0`, `pytest-cov`, `pytest-mock`, `ruff`) specifically quantified in the configuration requirements? [Clarity, Plan §Phase 1, Tasks §T001]
- [ ] CHK010 Is 100% offline isolation explicitly required for the test suite (prohibiting external network socket calls)? [Completeness, Tasks §T015, Quickstart §2.1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is an explicit End-to-End acceptance scenario specified for the test runner? [Measurability, Plan §Phase 1, Tasks §T019]
- [ ] CHK012 Are offline HTML and JSON fixture structures defined to represent realistic Film2Media markup (homepage, quick-search, listing, movie, series)? [Completeness, Tasks §T004-T008]

---

## 4. Error Paths & Interruption Resilience

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for handling missing or malformed HTML/JSON fixture files during test execution? [Edge Case, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK014 Are test runner timeout and cancellation behaviors specified to prevent hanging test suites? [Resilience, Tasks §T015]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the preservation of legacy `Ctrl+C` interrupt handling in `f2m.py` verified as an invariant during this phase? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Tasks §T020]

---

## 5. Documentation Parity & Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are developer environment setup commands (`pip install -e ".[dev]"`) documented for `README.md`? [Completeness, Plan §Phase 1, Tasks §T016]
- [ ] CHK017 Is exact bilingual parity required between English (`README.md`) and Persian (`README.fa.md`) for developer and testing instructions? [Consistency, Constitution Principle V, Tasks §T017]
- [ ] CHK018 Are test execution commands (`pytest`) documented consistently across both languages? [Consistency, Tasks §T022]

---

## 6. Reviewability & PR Readiness Gate

- [ ] CHK019 Is the human-only merge authority ("Only the repository owner may merge a PR") explicitly stated in the phase requirements and tasks? [Governance, Constitution Principle VII, Tasks §Governance]
- [ ] CHK020 Are step-by-step manual verification instructions specified with reproducible copy-paste commands? [Clarity, Tasks §T023, Quickstart §2]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a 7-step mandatory verification gate established to block completion until unit tests, E2E tests, regression safety, linting, docs, and manual checks pass? [Completeness, Tasks §6]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the phase definition guarantee that the repository remains in an operational and runnable state after merging? [Completeness, Constitution Principle VI, Plan §Phase 1]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
